Every factual claim this demo makes about Northern Birch Credit Union, where it came from, and when it was last checked. Anything not checked is listed under [Open items](#open-items) — **29 today**.

## What this site is

- An illustrative proposal prepared by Oodler Inc. It is not a live Northern Birch Credit Union service. Every page carries a banner and a footer saying so.
- Behind a password, and `noindex, nofollow` on every page. See `docs/password-protection.md`.
- Insurance is **referral only**. The site does not quote, advise on, sell or bind insurance. The words it uses are "connect you with" and "refer you to".
- Forms collect nothing: submissions are discarded (`netlify/functions/demo-intake.mjs`). The advisor chat's retention is in `docs/DATA-RETENTION.md`.

## Claims the build refuses

These were corrected once, after the content review. `scripts/check-claims.mjs` stops any of them from coming back:

- Stale 3-year rate; it is 4.59% (3-year closed)
- Stale 5-year high-ratio rate; it is 3.65% (5-year variable high ratio)
- Wrong rate guarantee; it is a 130-day rate guarantee
- The Personal's claims line; they are not a current partner
- CUMIS's claims line; they are not a current partner
- Manulife's group line; not a confirmed partner
- Invented travel product; the real one is Allianz Global Assistance (agency code 8528)
- Invented travel medical maximum
- Invented travel eligibility claim
- The real products are internationally sent wires and advance-order euro/USD cash in branch
- The entity was formed in 2020; its roots date to 1954 (Estonian CU) and 1959 (Latvian CU)
- Co-op insurance is not a product; the real co-op offering is mortgage lending
- They run an estates function for deceased member accounts -- administration, not planning
- Implies quoting; an unlicensed credit union may refer, not quote
- Implies advising or binding
- Invented discount or track record; no source for it
- Invented premium; Northern Birch does not quote insurance
- The assistant may not recommend a product or compare prices; it refers
- Co-op is not an insurance line; the real co-op offering is mortgage lending
- Names a vendor nobody has confirmed Northern Birch uses
- A data-handling claim the demo cannot make: AI messages are processed by Anthropic in the US
- Implies binding coverage
